name: Dredge Mining Collective
full_legal_name: Dredge Sovereign Mining Collective & Substrate Recovery Authority
sector: Deep Mining, Lakebed Extraction & Rare Earth Recovery
sovereign_territory: The Dredge Concessions — sovereign extraction rights to 340,000 square kilometers of Great Lakes lakebed, plus four onshore processing megafacilities in former Toledo, Windsor, Superior, and Green Bay. Unique sovereign designation: Dredge holds 'vertical sovereignty' — legal control of everything from the lakebed surface down to 800 meters depth, but no surface territorial rights.
founding_story: Dredge was not founded by a single visionary but by a consortium of 140 independent mining operators, indigenous resource-rights holders, and salvage firms who pooled their lakebed claims in 2140 to resist acquisition by Ouroboros Energy, which was attempting to monopolize Great Lakes subsurface rights for geothermal tapping. The 'Lakebed Compact' that created Dredge was signed on a decommissioned ore freighter in Lake Superior and remains the only corponation founding document written in three languages simultaneously: English, French, and Anishinaabemowin. The collective structure means Dredge has no single CEO — it is governed by a 23-seat Extraction Council elected by substrate-share.
security_force: Dredge Depth Security (DDS) — 14,000 personnel, specializing in underwater and sub-aquatic operations. Operate a fleet of 200 armed submersibles and 800 autonomous lakebed sentinels. DDS is the only corporate security force in Meridian with sovereign authority below the waterline. Their surface operations are deliberately minimal — Dredge's philosophy is that the best defense is making the lakebed unnavigable to anyone without their cooperation.
key_detail: Dredge's lakebed operations have uncovered three pre-Meridian industrial dumping sites containing materials of significant strategic value — including a sealed cache of pre-collapse military hardware in Lake Erie that Arcturus Defense Solutions has been attempting to acquire through legal, extralegal, and reportedly physical means for six years.
relationship_to_big_20: Ranked #14. In ongoing legal and physical conflict with Arcturus Defense Solutions over the Lake Erie cache. Supplies rare earth materials to Zheng-Dao Bioelectric, Helix Biosystems, and Cinderblock AI. Ouroboros Energy remains a hostile rival from the founding conflict, with both corponations contesting overlapping subsurface rights annually.
